:::{#exm-lotus-continuous}
#### Expected value of $X^2$ for a Uniform(0,1) variable

Let $X \sim \text{Uniform}(0,1)$ ([uniform distribution](random-variables.qmd#def-uniform)),
so $\p(X=x) = 1$ for $x \in [0,1]$.
By LOTUS (@thm-lotus, continuous case):

$$
\ba
\E{X^2}
&= \int_0^1 x^2 \cd \p(X=x)\,dx
&& \text{(LOTUS, continuous case)}
\\&= \int_0^1 x^2 \cd 1\,dx
&& \text{(}\p(X=x) = 1\text{ on } [0,1]\text{)}
\\&= \sb{\frac{x^3}{3}}_0^1
&& \text{(antiderivative of } x^2\text{)}
\\&= \frac{1}{3}.
&& \text{(evaluate at the bounds)}
\ea
$$

:::
